plain_english: Distinct from the illumination of sun, moon, lamp and the rest, it does not shine — on account of over-pervasion; and hence: of the nature of light, just this much — illumined-illuminator named is mere convention.
sanskrit_cite: arkendudīpādi avabhāsa bhinnam na ābhāti ativyāptatayā ca | tataḥ prakāśarūpam tad iyat prakāśyaprakāśatākhyā vyavahāraḥ eva
